dish_name: spicy tofu with stir-fried zucchini and miso soup
components: spicy tofu with chili, garlic and spring onion
source: generic recipe written by claude-opus-5-5 from the dish name only; not taken from any recording

ingredients.name: chili paste or chili bean sauce

steps.component: spicy tofu with chili, garlic and spring onion
steps.text: Fetch the firm tofu, silken tofu, zucchini, chilies, spring onions and miso from the fridge
steps.checkpoint: fridge items are on the counter

steps.component: spicy tofu with chili, garlic and spring onion
steps.text: Fetch the garlic, cornstarch, chili paste, soy sauce, sugar, oils, salt, dashi and wakame from the pantry
steps.checkpoint: pantry items are on the counter

steps.component: spicy tofu with chili, garlic and spring onion
steps.text: Get out the frying pan, wok, saucepan, cutting board, knife, bowls, towel and ladle

steps.component: spicy tofu with chili, garlic and spring onion
steps.text: Press the firm tofu dry with a towel and cut it into cubes

steps.component: spicy tofu with chili, garlic and spring onion
steps.text: Toss the tofu cubes in cornstarch and salt

steps.component: spicy tofu with chili, garlic and spring onion
steps.text: Mince the garlic, slice the chilies and slice the spring onions
steps.checkpoint: garlic, chili and spring onions are cut

steps.component: spicy tofu with chili, garlic and spring onion
steps.text: Mix the chili paste, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil and a splash of water into a sauce

steps.component: spicy tofu with chili, garlic and spring onion
steps.text: Pan-fry the tofu in oil until crisp and golden on all sides

steps.component: spicy tofu with chili, garlic and spring onion
steps.text: Add half the garlic and chili, then the sauce, and toss to glaze; finish with spring onions
steps.checkpoint: tofu is glazed and topped with spring onions

steps.text: Halve the zucchini lengthwise and slice into half-moons
Stir-fry the zucchini with the remaining garlic in hot oil in the wok, seasoning with soy sauce and salt
steps.checkpoint: zucchini is tender-crisp and lightly browned

steps.text: Soak the wakame in water and cut the silken tofu into small cubes
steps.checkpoint: wakame is rehydrated and tofu cubed

steps.text: Heat the dashi in the saucepan until just below a boil
Add the tofu and wakame, then turn the heat low and dissolve the miso in the soup
steps.checkpoint: miso is dissolved and soup is cloudy

steps.text: Ladle the soup into bowls and top with some spring onions

steps.component: spicy tofu with chili, garlic and spring onion
steps.text: Serve the spicy tofu, zucchini and miso soup together
steps.checkpoint: all three dishes are on the table
